about: Saint-Amable is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, on the South Shore east of Montréal toward Verchères and the Richelieu corridor. Suburban neighbourhoods, parks, and quick highway access define a residential Montréal-region community that grew rapidly from rural roots. About 13,000 people live in Saint-Amable.
